Use to shoot a projectile dealing magic damage

Every 7 seconds, gain a charge of Pyroclasm(Can store 3 charges): Deals 250% of ATK Arts damage in the next attack; Targets' gain Immolation for 3 seconds

item.yqils_arknights.typhon_greatbow.des:
Shift right click to trigger "Eternal Hunt": Immediately marks a target within 10 block radius with most health, Attack Interval lengthens significantly, and attacks become a hail of arrows aimed at the marked target; the hail of arrows will randomly strike enemies around the marked target, dealing 5 hits of 175% ATK + arrow damage as Physical damage and stunning targets hit 0.4 seconds
Skill activation grants 10 ammo and the skill ends when all ammo are used
Shift right click again during the skill to end it early
